method: CDP direct capture against a real Electron instance (apps/shell), following docs/e2e-method with --no-sandbox. codex's own sandboxed attempt aborted the Electron binary at launch (exit 134, could not open a CDP port); the wrapper re-ran the same fixture outside that constraint per the wrapper-codex.md verification allowance and captured the screenshots below.

fixture.note: same caption/emphasis data as packages/render-cut/evidence/emphasis-render/render-evidence.mjs (caption words, emphasisWords e-0001 t_start=1 t_end=1.9 word=やばい one-char-bang) so the same wall-clock times project onto the same token state on both sides

screenshots.preview-t0.7.png: video.currentTime=0.7: emphasis token not yet fired (all 3 characters opacity 0) - caption shows これは / (gap) / です, matching render-t0.7.png
screenshots.preview-t1.0.png: video.currentTime=1.0: exactly at the emphasis word's t_start; first character's animation is at 0% progress (opacity 0, scale 1.6) so it is still invisible - visually identical to t0.7, matching render-t1.0.png byte-identical-to-t0.7 result
screenshots.preview-t1.3.png: video.currentTime=1.3: first character (や) has completed its bang-in (opacity 1, scale 1) and is visible; remaining 2 characters (ば/い) still pending - matches render-t1.3.png

domStateAtLastSample.note: getComputedStyle read directly from the live DOM at t=1.3, confirms the visual read above numerically
